comparison.objective: Load a tool holder upward into a spindle while another arm holds a tab; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests upward keyed insertion and bimanual fixture/tab stabilization; candidate tests recessed hex-key use, counterholding, fine adjustment, controlled locking torque, and iterative impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the holder retained in the spindle after release; candidate requires two quantitatively safe stops and a drift-resistant collar setting.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; spindle insertion/retention and damper tuning test different abilities. No spec versions or insertion depth, orientation, retention, and force thresholds are given.
